alternatives.name: Keep Union[X, Y] as the only syntax
alternatives.description: Continue using Union[X, Y] from typing module for union types.
alternatives.reason_rejected: Union[X, Y] is verbose and requires importing from typing. The | operator is more intuitive and consistent with set-theoretic type notation.

alternatives.name: Use 'or' keyword for unions
alternatives.description: Use 'int or str' syntax for union types using the 'or' keyword.
alternatives.reason_rejected: The 'or' keyword is already a boolean operator. Overloading it for type expressions would create parsing ambiguity and confusion.
